name: get_store_hours
description: Look up a retail store's opening hours, holiday closures and time zone. Use for questions about when a physical location opens or closes.
argument_description: The identifier of the physical retail store.

name: get_store_accessibility
description: Find wheelchair access, step-free entrances, hearing assistance and accessible facilities at a physical store.
argument_description: The identifier of the physical retail store.

name: get_parking_options
description: Find nearby parking facilities, parking fees and validation rules for visitors to a retail location.
argument_description: The identifier of the physical retail store.

name: get_store_events
description: List scheduled demonstrations, community events and classes at a store, including event times and registration requirements.
argument_description: The identifier of the physical retail store.

name: get_gift_card_balance
description: Look up the remaining monetary balance on a gift card and its currency. Use for gift-card balance enquiries.
argument_description: The public reference of the gift card; never a PIN.

name: get_gift_card_terms
description: Read gift-card expiry, redemption restrictions and supported currencies for a country.
argument_description: Two-letter country code for the gift-card programme.

name: get_loyalty_points
description: Look up a loyalty member's available points balance, points expiry dates and current membership tier.
argument_description: The identifier of the loyalty programme member.

name: get_loyalty_rewards
description: List the rewards and member benefits available at a loyalty tier, including redemption thresholds.
argument_description: The loyalty membership tier to inspect.

name: get_coupon_terms
description: Read a promotional coupon's validity dates, minimum spend and restrictions on combining offers.
argument_description: The promotional coupon code.

name: get_campaign_schedule
description: Look up a marketing campaign's planned start, end and publication channels.
argument_description: The identifier of the marketing campaign.

name: get_newsletter_preferences
description: Read a subscriber's selected newsletter topics and delivery frequency. This lookup does not change subscriptions.
argument_description: The identifier of the newsletter subscriber.

name: get_invoice_copy
description: Find an existing invoice's document reference, billing date, subtotal and tax breakdown.
argument_description: The identifier of an issued invoice.

name: get_payment_schedule
description: Read instalment due dates and scheduled amounts for a payment agreement.
argument_description: The identifier of the instalment payment agreement.

name: get_tax_exemption_status
description: Check the validity dates and jurisdictions of an existing business tax-exemption certificate.
argument_description: The identifier of the tax-exemption certificate.

name: get_business_account_contacts
description: List the purchasing and billing contact roles recorded on a business account.
argument_description: The identifier of the business account.

name: get_subscription_renewal
description: Read the next renewal date, billing interval and current status of a service subscription.
argument_description: The identifier of the service subscription.

name: get_subscription_features
description: List the service features and usage allowances included in a subscription plan.
argument_description: The identifier of the subscription plan.

name: get_delivery_tracking
description: Look up a carrier shipment's latest scan, delivery estimate and transit status.
argument_description: The carrier tracking reference for a shipment.

name: get_delivery_slot
description: Read the date and time window of a booked home delivery, including arrival instructions.
argument_description: The identifier of the home-delivery booking.

name: get_pickup_locker
description: Find a collection locker's location, access hours and physical accessibility information.
argument_description: The identifier of the collection locker.

name: get_installation_booking
description: Read an appliance installation appointment's date, technician arrival window and preparation checklist.
argument_description: The identifier of the appliance installation booking.

name: get_recycling_locations
description: Find nearby electronics recycling collection points and the materials they accept.
argument_description: The postal code around which to search for recycling locations.

name: get_recycling_rules
description: Read disposal and collection requirements for packaging, batteries and other recyclable materials.
argument_description: The material type for which disposal guidance is needed.

name: get_training_class
description: Read the schedule, syllabus and attendance requirements for a customer training class.
argument_description: The identifier of the training class.

name: get_job_openings
description: List published job vacancies and application closing dates at a store or office location.
argument_description: The identifier of the hiring location.

name: get_supplier_certificate
description: Read the compliance certificate references and expiry dates recorded for a supplier.
argument_description: The identifier of the supplier.

name: get_procurement_status
description: Look up an internal procurement order's approval stage, supplier confirmation and expected delivery date.
argument_description: The identifier of an internal purchase order.

name: get_warehouse_hours
description: Read goods-receiving hours and loading-dock appointment requirements at a warehouse.
argument_description: The identifier of the warehouse.

name: get_sustainability_report
description: Find published annual sustainability metrics, reporting boundaries and the report document reference.
argument_description: The four-digit year of the sustainability report.

name: get_press_release
description: Retrieve a published corporate announcement's title, date and public press-release text.
argument_description: The identifier of the published announcement.
